execute_command: run a shell command using subprocess Popen with optional wait and output redirection
execute_command_wait: run a shell command and wait for it to complete before returning
is_workflow_check: check if a model URL is a workflow by testing if it ends with .war
is_file_empty_check: check if a file exists and is empty by confirming its size is 0 bytes
execute_command_redirect: run a shell command with stdout and stderr redirected to custom streams
